name: multiple_choice: The dragons.csv file contains data on 2000 magnificent beasts…

request.questionText: The dragons.csv file contains data on 2000 magnificent beasts randomly sampled from the extensive Care of Magical Creatures database. Variables include: color -- color of dragon (black, blue, green, red) height -- dragon height in yards The distribution of height for dragons is unimodal and symmetric. Which of the following is closest to the probability of observing a dragon shorter than 58 yards?
